post.headline: Keep tip alerts tied to your review workflow
post.subtext: Notification settings help recipients decide where new-message alerts go and how much encrypted content belongs in email.

post.rationale: Selected the desktop notification settings screenshot because the alternative directory candidate repeats yesterday's directory theme and a heavily used topic family. This plan uses the recipient-shared context from the Hush Line use cases: journalists, lawyers, educators, nonprofits, and other trusted recipients need manageable alert routing for incoming tips while keeping source submission low-friction.
